title: Ring Stack Match
description: Drag concentric neon color rings onto a sleek grid—align three matching rings across rows, columns, or diagonals to ignite chain-reaction clears.
controls: Drag incoming concentric rings onto open pegs to match three of the same color in a row or stack.

zh-CN.title: 环与环
zh-CN.description: 极简烧脑套环三消神作：把大中小霓虹彩环拖进九宫格，横竖斜或同格三色连消触发炫酷连击停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动下方出现的彩色圆环放置到棋盘格点上，凑齐三个同色圆环即可消除得分。
